payload.title: Discord: posts, rate limits, mentions and reader DMs
payload.description:
**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Coarse until M3 ships.

**Build.**
Always send `allowed_mentions: {"parse": []}`, so a headline's `@everyone` pings nobody (webhooks parse user mentions by default, ordinary messages everything). Limits: read `X-RateLimit-*` headers and `Retry-After`, do not hard-code. The global limit is 50 requests per second; 10,000 invalid requests per 10 minutes earns a temporary ban, so stop retrying 401s and 403s. Content 2,000 characters; embeds 6,000 in total. FIFO SQS group per webhook. Reader DMs: Discord says DMs should generally come from a user action, not to DM a whole server, and that opening many quickly can get a bot blocked. Build after channel posts, in a paced trial, per the plan's decision.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started: `@everyone` in a headline pings nobody.

**Depends on:** kanbus-f4ad82, kanbus-5acd4e
